title: Austria's Foreign Ministry says unauthorised access via an external provider's web page exposed staff contact details
date_note: Date of the ministry's statement as relayed by EFE; the ministry says the access took place on 12 and 13 November 2026 and was detected on 13 November.
geo_basis: ministry headquarters in Vienna, as named by the source
summary: According to EFE, relayed by ABC Color, Austria's Foreign Ministry said in a statement that unauthorised access on 12 and 13 November through a web page run by an external service provider exposed names and professional contact details of staff in Vienna and at its missions abroad. It was detected on 13 November and blocked. The ministry says an analysis ruled out compromise of citizens' personal data.
plain: Austria's Foreign Ministry says attackers reached a provider's web page and saw work contact details of its staff. It says citizens' personal data was not affected.
exec: A supplier's web page was the way in to a foreign ministry's staff directory data, a reminder to check what third-party sites can reach.

validation.note: One EFE wire story republished by ABC Color, citing the ministry's own statement; the statement itself was not read.

review.note: Compared title, summary, dates, external-provider web page vector, staff contact details, citizens data ruled out and no attribution against the EFE story on ABC Color; confirmed rests on the ministry statement quoted there
